description: A list of authorized devices with details such as browser, OS, location, and last active time. Each non-current device has a revoke button.

keyboard.action: Navigates between revoke buttons across device entries

focus.notes: Focus follows natural tab order through the revoke buttons. The current device entry does not have a revoke button and is skipped in tab order.

announcements: Each device entry announces its name, browser, OS, and location
The revoke button is announced with a label identifying the device
The current device is indicated as the active session

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for all text)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for borders and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Ensure onRevoke communicates the result (success or failure) to the user
Revoke buttons should include context about which device is being revoked
